summary: WhiteHorse Finance, Inc., a Nasdaq-listed business development company, filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026 announcing that its board formed a special committee of independent directors to explore strategic alternatives, potentially including a sale or other corporate transaction. No timetable was set, no terms, price, premium, or advisor were disclosed, and the company stated it will not comment further unless a definitive course of action is approved or the review concludes. The review creates optionality over the BDC's portfolio and management relationship; watch for committee composition, retention of a financial advisor, any 13D activity, and discount-to-NAV narrowing as the risk-arb signal.
